newsitem.title: USA: All-Comm says withdraws IPO filing with SEC.
newsitem.headline: All-Comm says withdraws IPO filing with SEC.

text.p: All-Comm Media Corp said it will withdraw its filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell 2.1 million shares of its common stock in an initial public offering because of market conditions.
The 2.1 million shares includes 350,000 million shares to have been offered by certain selling shareholders, the company said.
The company said it will seek alternate financing possibilities as a result of its decision to withdraw the registration statement.
It did not provide details and officials at the company were not immediately available to comment further.
